name: Village Square
description: The open heart of the village, with a stone fountain, benches, and a view of the cafe and bookshop fronts.

name: Hobbs Cafe
description: The village cafe. Counter, tables, and the till at the front; kitchen behind.

name: Cafe Kitchen
description: The working kitchen behind the cafe counter. Coat hooks, sink, mop bucket in the corner.

name: Cafe Storage Room
description: A cramped storage room behind the kitchen, stacked with crates. A rear door opens onto the alley.

name: Rear Alley
description: A narrow service alley running behind the cafe and bookshop. Bins, crates, and the cafe's rear door.

name: Reed & Bell Bookshop
description: Isabella Reed's bookshop, part-funded by Marcus Bell. Its back door opens onto the rear alley.

name: Village Clinic
description: A small clinic on the square where Nadia Cole works the early shift.

name: Marcus Bell's House
description: Marcus's house on the edge of the square. His study holds the cafe's books.

name: Owen Price's House & Yard
description: Owen's house and builder's timber yard on the far side of the square.

name: Flat above Hobbs Cafe
description: Clara Wells's small flat above the cafe, reached by a side stair.

name: Fountain
description: The stone fountain in the middle of the village square.
